body:
Activates REQ-118 planning (owner request 2026-10-07). The QT4CG drafts crossed a process threshold — the XPath 4.0 document is now a **WG Review Draft (W3C Editor's Draft, 15 Sept 2026)** — so the recorded 'first 4.0 sub-feature REQ drafted once the drafts stabilize' acceptance criterion is checked with a verified inventory.

**New dossier `docs/REQ-118-xpath-xslt-40.md`:**
- **Spec audit (§1)** — verified against the live qt4cg.org drafts + change-history blocks (not memory): the CG renamed ` =>> ` → ` =!> `; `fn:all`/`fn:some-of` never existed (`fn:all-equal`/`fn:all-different`/`fn:some`/`fn:every` are the real names); `scan-left/right` consolidated into `fn:scan`; no `switch` expression in XPath (`xsl:switch` is XSLT-only).
- **Stability tiers** — stable ≥1.5 yr (pipeline `->`, mapping `=!>`, `??`, string templates, keyword args, focus functions, `for member`, most new F&O functions) vs post-June-2026 churn (nominative records, `=?>`, `fn:scan`, JNode rules).
- **Ranked candidates (§2)** — Tier 1 pure F&O 4.0 functions (FunctionLibrary wave, qt4tests sets ready) → Tier 2 stable grammar → Tier 3 enums/choices/structural records → Tier 4 XSLT surfaces (pattern system last). Deferrals recorded: XDM 4.0 JNode model, `fn:parse-html`, nominative records, `=?\>`, `fn:scan`.
- **Version gating (§3)** — Option A (recommended): compile-surface version switch, default 3.1, so the 100.0% XSLT 3.0 basic gate stays byte-identical. **Owner decision pending.**
- **Slices (§4)** — 4.0-S1…S8, each to become its own sub-REQ when scheduled; **no slice before the paired `v1.0.0` tags** (recorded sequencing rule).

**Registry/sync:** FEATURE_REQUESTS REQ-118 row + section (planning-activated, dossier link, decision-log entry); ROADMAP 0.13.0 soak row checked (`v0.13.0` tagged, PR #76); AGENT_HANDOVER fifty-second session block.

Docs-only. `v0.13.0` soak is the issues/discussions window; §5 owner decisions gate sub-REQ 4.0-S1.
title: docs(req-118): XPath/XSLT 4.0 adoption plan — WG Review Draft inventory + slices 4.0-S1…S8
